name: io.github.tudorgrigoriu90/sverige-begagnad-mcp
title: Sverige Begagnad
description: Search Swedish second-hand marketplaces (Blocket, Tradera, Klaravik, Vinted) for quality used items to flip.

environmentVariables.name: TRADERA_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Tradera App ID from api.tradera.com/register.

environmentVariables.name: TRADERA_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tradera App Key (GUID secret) from api.tradera.com/register.

environmentVariables.name: BLOCKET_LOCATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated Blocket region (län) names to scope searches; empty = all of Sweden.
